titulo: He bet against the Buddha and lost 500 years 🐒 Sun Wukong Part 5 (Final) #story #shorts
descripcion:
After 49 days in Laozi's furnace, the Monkey King bursts out with golden eyes and nobody in Heaven can stop him. Then the Buddha offers one bet: jump out of my palm. Five pillars, one message, and a mountain that falls for five hundred years.

Final part of the series. Watch from part 1 on the channel.
Would you have taken the bet?

From Journey to the West (Xiyouji), Wu Cheng'en, 16th century, chapters 7 and 14.
